sources.locator: Title search: 密码模块标准（FIPS 140）

statement.zh: **术语**：密码模块标准（FIPS 140）（FIPS 140）。FIPS 140-3 的题目是「Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules」，范围是「a cryptographic module utilized within a security system protecting sensitive but unclassified information」，并声明本文件覆盖的实现「including, but not limited to, hardware components or modules, software/firmware programs or modules or any combination thereof」。标准给出「four increasing, qualitative levels of security: Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4」。
statement.en: **Term**: FIPS 140.It is registered under applied security engineering, key management.

statement.zh: 标准把要求组织为十一个领域：模块规范、接口、角色服务与认证、软件/固件安全、运行环境、物理安全、非侵入式安全、敏感安全参数管理、自测试、生命周期保障与其他攻击缓解；§1 说明「Four security levels were specified for each of eleven requirement areas」。¶7 要求所选安全级别与应用的 security requirements of the application and environment 相称，并且某个级别的要求包含该级特有要求加上对所有模块通用的要求。FIPS 140-3 与 ISO/IEC 19790:2012/Cor.1:2015 与 ISO/IEC 24759:2017 对齐（§2）。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in applied security engineering, key management, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 合规性由「The Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP) validates cryptographic modules to Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 140-3」执行，该计划由 NIST 与加拿大网络安全中心联合运行，厂商通过 NVLAP 认可的独立 CST 实验室测试。¶10 规定模块「shall employ Approved security functions such as cryptographic algorithms, cryptographic key management techniques, and authentication techniques」，批准算法与物理安全要求分别由附录与 SP 800-140 系列文档给出。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 标准自身在 ¶13 声明符合性不等同于安全：「conformance to this standard is not sufficient to ensure that a particular module is secure」，并规定标准至少每五年复审。¶7 把级别选择的责任交给使用方，级别只是定性分档；¶6 允许已经批准用于涉密用途的模块替代按本标准验证的模块，因此已通过 140-3 并非唯一可用路径。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: FIPS 140-3 于 2019 年 3 月 22 日发布，「This standard supersedes FIPS 140-2, Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules, in its entirety」；§1 回顾「In 2001, FIPS 140-2 superseded FIPS 140-1」，并说明 140-3 的主要变化限于引入非侵入式物理要求。¶12 给出生效与过渡安排：标准在商务部长批准后六个月生效，并为测试实验室提供至少六个月的过渡期，图中另标出 140-3 测试开始与 140-2 测试结束。
statement.en: Registered period: Age of Standardization.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
